auth.passwordMinLength: Password must be at least 8 characters
auth.needSetup: Not initialized yet. Create the admin account first.

gravitas.title: Gravitas control status
gravitas.subtitle: Read-only diagnostic snapshot; viewing it does not probe dependencies or update policy.
gravitas.unavailable: The current process has not provided Gravitas status.
gravitas.noFacts: There are no facts to display.
gravitas.noAckItems: No adapter acknowledgements; policy application acknowledgement is not wired yet.

offline.title: Backend is not running
offline.hint: Cannot reach the Stella bot process. Desktop users: start the bot from the desktop shell first. Browser users: verify the address and port.

system.coreUnavailable: The core is unavailable; the control plane is still online, so you can repair configuration. Chat requests are not retried automatically.
system.externalConflict: An external .env edit was detected. Reload and confirm the configuration source before saving again.
system.restored: Apply failed; the previous configuration was restored.
system.recoveryFailed: Restoring the previous configuration failed; the core is still unavailable. Review the error summary and retry.
system.controllerRestart: This configuration requires a Corona control-plane restart. Status tracking will resume when the service returns.
system.reconnectingDetail: The control plane is temporarily unreachable. Your login session is retained and runtime status will resync when it returns.

platforms.title: Platforms
platforms.subtitle: Adapters and connections
platforms.intro: Choose the NoneBot adapter modules to load and review active Bot connections. Install adapter packages and configure their credentials separately.
platforms.introManaged: Choose the NoneBot adapter modules to load and review core connections. Saving creates a configuration revision and applies it while the control plane remains available during core restart.
platforms.modulesLabel: Python module paths (one per line or comma-separated)
platforms.modulesHint: Default: nonebot.adapters.onebot.v11. Changes take effect after restart. An empty list disables all Bot adapters. This field does not install modules or accept credentials.
platforms.modulesHintManaged: Default: nonebot.adapters.onebot.v11. The control plane applies changes after saving. An empty list disables all adapters. This field does not install modules or accept credentials.
platforms.processOverride: A process environment variable overrides the module list in .env. The saved value takes effect after removing that override.
platforms.modulesSaved: Adapter modules saved; restart to apply
platforms.onebotConfigHint: Multiple forward WebSocket URLs are supported. The access token is never returned; leave it blank to keep the current value.
platforms.onebotSaved: OneBot settings saved; restart to apply
platforms.noOnebotNeeded: OneBot V11 is not enabled. NapCat link checks do not apply; Stella can still use other configured adapters or WebChat.
platforms.onebotNotReady: The OneBot V11 link is not ready. Check that the adapter is enabled and that NapCat's WebSocket address matches this service.
platforms.noConnections: There are no connected Bot instances.
platforms.host: Listen address (reverse mode; use 0.0.0.0 for a remote adapter)
platforms.wsUrlsHint: Use one ws:// or wss:// URL per line or comma-separated; leave blank for reverse WS.
platforms.accessTokenHint: Must match the adapter-side value; blank leaves the current token unchanged.
platforms.restartHint: Saved to the local .env file. Restart to apply.
platforms.restartHintManaged: Saving creates a configuration revision and asks the control plane to apply it.

providers.managedSaveHint: Saving persists the configuration first, then starts one core apply. The status bar above shows saved, applied, and readiness state.
